# 比较在部分所及之内决定：覆盖部分在每步之前已到达者的任何意义，对有与无部分的水平作公理的比较；任意两个流的比较在其差别所及之内决定 / The comparison is decided within what the part reaches: any significance covering what the part has reached before each step compares the levels with and without it as the axiom does; the comparison of any two flows is decided within what their difference reaches

## 主张 Claim

设流平衡，l 是扣留部分时的水平。两个意义从立场 p 在每步对部分此前已到达者一致（一个在部分已到达处不多于另一个时，保留与不增加就从后者传到前者：Flow.Balances.retains_transfer、not_adds_transfer），就对有与无部分的水平作同样的四个比较（Flow.Balances.comparison_local）。对覆盖部分在每步之前已到达者的任何意义，有部分的水平保留无部分的水平上有意义者，恰当前者包含后者，反过来也是；两者都不增加有意义的延续，恰当两者都不超出对方（Flow.Balances.comparison_within_reach）：这正是公理之下的比较（Web.retains_iff_includes、Web.adds_iff_exceeds）。意义可判定时，增加恰是超出（Flow.Balances.adds_iff_exceeds_of_decidable）；对每个意义，超出给出双重否定之下的增加（Flow.Balances.not_not_adds_of_exceeds）。以对影响封闭、含部分成员的区域为界的意义，对这个部分作包含那样的比较，不用公理（Flow.Balances.closed_comparison）；所及闭包是含中心的最小这样的区域，系统也是一个。两个起始相同的平衡的流，水平在某步不同之处，两者在该条件上的取用或给予在更早的步不同（Flow.DiffersBefore、Flow.Balances.differs_before）；覆盖这一差别在每步之前所到达者的任何意义，对两个流作公理的比较（Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference）。见证：Clearing 中从清除者的立场，以各系统为界的意义判它的部分失去栖居者，以各影响闭包为界判它保留（Clearing.system_counts_dweller）；以各所及闭包为界的意义不是公理，却与公理一样判这一部分失去栖居者（Clearing.reach_counts_dweller）；来源给出清除者所取，其余交换不变时没有水平平衡扣留来源的流，这一比较不存在（Clearing.no_levels_without_source）。Margin 中部分到达形成的影响闭包之外，有它时的水平包含无它时的，每个意义都保留：覆盖足够而不必要（Margin.reach_without_misjudgment）。营养级联 Trophic 中，狼群的部分不到达森林（Trophic.wolves_unreached），其余交换固定时森林每步有与无它同样被接纳，部分缩小，关闭鹿（Trophic.deer_without_wolves），公理之下从任何立场都不保留（Trophic.mediated_unregistered）；对照鹿有回应的流，同一取用是混合的，公理之下两条水平路径都不保留对方上有意义者（Trophic.responsive_mixed）；狼群的部分不到达森林，而两个流的差别在第 3 步之前到达它（Trophic.difference_reaches_forest）；远处形成的系统只含它自己（Trophic.far_system），从它的立场，以各系统为界的意义判远处形成与狼群的联合部分保留，公理之下它失去鹿（Trophic.mixed_part）。一般定理不用公理；公理 Unrestricted 只作为三个见证的假设出现。 / Let the flow balance and l be the levels with a part withheld. Two significances that agree, from standpoint p, at each step on what the part has reached before it (retaining and not adding carry over from one to another that has no more significance where the part has reached: Flow.Balances.retains_transfer, not_adds_transfer) make the same four comparisons of the levels with and without the part (Flow.Balances.comparison_local). For any significance covering what the part has reached before each step, the levels with the part retain what has significance along those without it exactly when they include them, and the reverse, and neither adds a continuation with significance exactly when neither exceeds the other (Flow.Balances.comparison_within_reach): the comparisons under the axiom (Web.retains_iff_includes, Web.adds_iff_exceeds). Where significance is decidable, adding is exceeding (Flow.Balances.adds_iff_exceeds_of_decidable); for every significance, exceeding gives adding up to double negation (Flow.Balances.not_not_adds_of_exceeds). Significance bounded by a region closed under affecting that holds the members of a part compares the part as inclusion does, with no axiom (Flow.Balances.closed_comparison); the reach closure is the least such region holding a center, and the system is one. Where the levels of two balanced flows from one start differ at a step, their taking from or giving to that condition differed at an earlier step (Flow.DiffersBefore, Flow.Balances.differs_before); any significance covering what the difference has reached before each step compares the two flows as the axiom does (Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference). Witnesses: in Clearing, from the clearer's standpoint, significance bounded by each system judges the clearer's part to lose the dweller, and bounded by each influence closure to retain (Clearing.system_counts_dweller); significance bounded by each reach closure is not the axiom, yet judges the part to lose the dweller as the axiom does (Clearing.reach_counts_dweller); the source gives what the clearer takes, and with the rest of the exchange fixed no levels balance the flow without the source's part, so that comparison does not exist (Clearing.no_levels_without_source). In Margin a part reaches beyond a formation's influence closure while the levels with it include those without, so every significance retains: covering is enough and not needed (Margin.reach_without_misjudgment). In Trophic, a trophic cascade, the wolves' part does not reach the forest (Trophic.wolves_unreached); with the rest of the exchange fixed the forest is admitted alike with and without it at every step, and the part narrows, closing the deer (Trophic.deer_without_wolves), so under the axiom it does not retain from any standpoint (Trophic.mediated_unregistered); against the flow in which the deer respond the same taking is mixed, and under the axiom neither level path retains along the other (Trophic.responsive_mixed); the wolves' part does not reach the forest while the difference between the two flows reaches it before the third step (Trophic.difference_reaches_forest); the far formation's system holds only itself (Trophic.far_system), and from its standpoint significance bounded by each system judges the joint part of the far formation and the wolves to retain, while under the axiom the part loses the deer (Trophic.mixed_part). The general theorems use no axiom; the axiom Unrestricted appears only as a hypothesis of three witnesses.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一般定理的前提只有平衡（Flow.Balances）；部分是判定的形成家族。 / The general theorems assume only balance (Flow.Balances); a part is a decided family of formations.
- 有与无一个部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels）：扣留这一部分、其余交换不变时的水平，这是表示上的选择；两个流的比较另给第二个流。 / Comparisons with and without a part use withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels): the levels with the part withheld and the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation; a comparison of two flows is given the second flow.
- 公理 Unrestricted 只作为三个见证的假设出现（Trophic.mediated_unregistered、responsive_mixed、mixed_part）；把它读作 Ren 的公理是 AI 的读法，待 Ren。 / The axiom Unrestricted appears only as a hypothesis of three witnesses (Trophic.mediated_unregistered, responsive_mixed, mixed_part); reading it as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, pending Ren.
- Trophic、Clearing 与 Margin 的结论：见证的流、网与部分（Trophic.wolvesPart、Trophic.withoutWolves、Trophic.farWolvesPart、Clearing.sourcePart、Margin.flow、Margin.web、Margin.takerPart）。 / For the Trophic, Clearing and Margin results: the witnesses' flows, webs and parts (Trophic.wolvesPart, Trophic.withoutWolves, Trophic.farWolvesPart, Clearing.sourcePart, Margin.flow, Margin.web, Margin.takerPart).
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 的长远目标：“I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”；Ren 要求“pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”。Ren 的层级：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：影响闭包读一个形成自身的反馈在效果经他者的支持与活动传递时所能识的；所及闭包读 Ren 中间的“the system that one is in”（P40 把供给闭包读作所在系统，这一读法撤回）；系统（对共享条件的闭包）界定每个效果，却不读那一层级：一个共同条件就使它成为整体，系统划分形成，没有嵌套与中心；“situational awareness”读作中心知道其部分在反馈之外所到达的。名称（ClosedUnder、WithinClosure、AffectedBy、WithinInfluence、Affects、WithinReach、TakesPart、Shares、WithinSystem、Reaches、ReachesBefore、DiffersBefore、Trophic 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选；营养级联是生态学用语。 / Ren's long-term objectives: “I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”; Ren asked to “pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”. Ren's levels: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the influence closure reads what a formation's own feedback can register once effects pass through the support and activity of others; the reach closure reads Ren's intermediate “the system that one is in” (P40 read the feeding closure as the system one is in; that reading is withdrawn); the system, the closure under sharing a condition, bounds every effect but does not read that level: one common condition makes it the whole, and systems partition the formations, with no nesting and no center; “situational awareness” reads as a center knowing what its part reaches beyond its feedback. The names (ClosedUnder, WithinClosure, AffectedBy, WithinInfluence, Affects, WithinReach, TakesPart, Shares, WithinSystem, Reaches, ReachesBefore, DiffersBefore, Trophic and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard; trophic cascade is the ecological term.

意义本身仍是给定的；对每个意义正面形式的增加比较只在意义可判定处推出，一般只到双重否定；以扣留水平的比较固定其余交换，他者有回应的比较须给出第二个流，回应的流在见证中是给出的；中心知道其所及不推出；读法与名称是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。 / Significance itself stays supplied; the adding comparisons in positive form follow for every significance only where it is decidable, and otherwise up to double negation; the comparison by withheld levels keeps the rest of the exchange fixed, a comparison in which others respond needs the second flow supplied, and responding flows are supplied in the witnesses; that a center knows what it reaches is not derived; the readings and names are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

- 其余交换固定时，经他者回应的效果不在比较中被识（Trophic.mediated_unregistered）；对照有回应的流，比较不同（Trophic.responsive_mixed）；部分给出他者所取时，比较可以不存在（Clearing.no_levels_without_source）。 / With the rest of the exchange fixed, effects through others' responses do not register in the comparison (Trophic.mediated_unregistered); against a responding flow the comparison differs (Trophic.responsive_mixed); where a part gives what others take, the comparison need not exist (Clearing.no_levels_without_source). ## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

不另给“其余只经其识回应”这一前提、由动力学给出回应的比较（在该前提下，P65 把比较定在回应所及之内，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：较弱版本是否读作覆盖中心所及的意义。 / A comparison whose responses the dynamics give without supplying that the rest responds only through its registration (under that premise P65 decides it within the responsive reach, comparison-where-the-rest-responds); how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the weaker version reads as significance covering what a center reaches.

Aliases / 别名: `Becoming.Flow.Balances.retains_transfer`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.not_adds_transfer`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_local`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_reach`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.adds_iff_exceeds_of_decidable`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.not_not_adds_of_exceeds`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.closed_comparison`, `Becoming.Flow.DiffersBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.differs_before`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference`, `Becoming.Clearing.system_counts_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.reach_counts_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.no_levels_without_source`, `Becoming.Margin.reach_without_misjudgment`, `Becoming.Trophic.wolves_unreached`, `Becoming.Trophic.deer_without_wolves`, `Becoming.Trophic.mediated_unregistered`, `Becoming.Trophic.responsive_mixed`, `Becoming.Trophic.difference_reaches_forest`, `Becoming.Trophic.far_system`, `Becoming.Trophic.mixed_part`
